messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: Primary oncall Emma Liang didn't acknowledge pager in 2m. Auto-fallback triggered. Routing set to 'secondary' for 15m. If you can cover, respond with 'taking' and tag @emma. Pager: P12345 — high error spike (5xx) for /v1/generate. https://monitoring.redwood.com/alerts/P12345

Emma Liang: Sorry team, stuck in security line at ORD, can barely keep phone on. Can someone pick up primary while I'm offline? I can hand the context.

Raj Patel: I can take primary for the next 3h. Emma, pass the quick context when you can. What about customer impact and mitigation we should run immediately?

Emma Liang: Thanks Raj. Brief: spike started ~08:12 UTC after canary deploy; affected hosted region us-west-2, about 7% errors, auto-fallback to lower-capacity nodes triggered. Suspect a quantized kernel regression causing timeouts. Suspending new deploys.

Derek Wu: I'll shadow Raj for the next 30m then switch to secondary. @SRE-runbooks-bot, please post the handoff checklist.

SRE-runbooks-bot: Handoff checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff
Steps:
1) Confirm pager routing: `./tools/routing set primary raj --duration 180m`
2) Ensure canary fallback policy is active: `kubectl -n inference describe config canary-policy`
3) Run the customer-impact script: `scripts/assess_customer_impact --alert P12345`
4) If suspect quantization, revert to previous image: `images/revert --model-serving stable-v2`

Emma Liang: Quick notes from my end: logs show repeated 503s and upstream timeouts on replica pool A. Error traces include OOM warnings at the kernel layer after the quantized serve binary loads. I left the failing pod IDs in the incident doc.

Raj Patel: Taking. Running routing now and notifying PD. Will also throttle heavy batch paths. Command run:
```
./tools/routing set primary raj --duration 180m --reason "EMMA travel - taking primary"
```
PagerDuty: https://pd.redwood.com/incidents/PD6789

Derek Wu: Confirmed. I'm connected to traces and will escalate if errors exceed 10% for 5m. I also applied a quick canary pause: `kubectl apply -f canary-pause.yaml`.

Emma Liang: Thanks both. If you need the quantized build hash: `qbuild-20260315-7f3a`. Artifacts at: https://artifacts.redwood.com/quantized/qbuild-20260315-7f3a.tar.gz

Raj Patel: Mitigation plan: 1) throttle incoming batch requests for size >1024, 2) divert traffic to region fallback us-east-1 for non-low-latency routes, 3) revert to stable v2 image on suspicious nodes. I'll update this thread when PD and support are notified. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: ROUTING UPDATE: Primary now Raj Patel. Secondary Derek Wu. Auto-fallback window set to 180m. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

Support-bot: Notified support with customer impact summary: ~7% error rate us-west-2 from 08:12 UTC. Ticket #SUP-2026 created and linked to PD incident. Support will prepare customer-facing blurb if needed.

Raj Patel: I've posted a short incident stub and scheduled a 30m follow-up to verify stability. Will escalate to infra if we see continuing kernel OOMs.

Derek Wu: Staying on watch for 25m then will formally assume secondary. If anyone needs traces or a quick runbook pointer, ping me.

Emma Liang: Appreciate you both. Boarding now, phone mostly off during takeoff. Leaving more notes in the incident doc. TTYL.
